brief: Breakout timing: AI job search tools are exploding with AI hiring surges.
Single best opportunity: ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search - AI-powered job search & application tool.
Leverage Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps for AI agent & RAG app inspiration.
AI job search tools are steady, with high demand and scalability.
Build a niche AI job search tool with unique features to stand out.

items.name: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.one_liner: Open-source collection of AI agents, skills, and RAG apps
items.pain_point: Businesses struggle to implement and integrate AI agents due to lack of ready-to-use, open-source solutions. They would pay for ease of use and customization.
app_ideas: AI Agent Marketplace: A platform to discover, customize, and deploy open-source AI agents tailored to specific business needs.
AI Agent Automation Tool: A no-code/low-code tool to automate business processes using the agents in the collection.
items.monetization: Freemium with enterprise-grade features and support available for a subscription fee.
items.why_now: Growing interest in AI agents and RAG systems, as seen by the repo's rapid growth in stars.

items.name: ai-job-search-dev/ai-job-search
items.pain_point: Job seekers struggling with manual application process, recruiters overwhelmed with applications
app_ideas: AI Job Search Assistant: Chrome extension for automated job application
AI Resume Builder & Cover Letter Generator: Standalone web app
items.monetization: Freemium with premium features for job seekers, and B2B API for recruiters
items.why_now: Growing interest in AI for job search, increasing demand for remote work
